value.description:
UBAR-9W V1.0.1 (Winterized): Laffs Dynamics

Variant of the RK Spookware UBAR-9, a AR-15 based lower receiver for chambering the 9x19mm cartridge. Uses double stack 9mm 
Glock magazines.

Design Variant Features: 

*Enlarged front of the trigger guard for use with gloves.

*Removed material behind trigger guard.

*Rounded the front section of the magwell.

*Added wrapped ridges down the front of the magwell.

*Added modifier designer's logo.

*Strengthened the mag release hinge point.

*Added channels within the magwell for less friction during insertion/removal.


Update V1.0.1: Redesignated design nomenclature.


Printer Used: Ender 3 V2

Filament Used: PLA+

Print Settings:

Extruder: 220C
Bed: 56C 
First Layer Print Height: .2mm 
Standard Layer Height: .16mm
Wall Perimeters: 8+ 
Infill: 50%+
Infill Pattern: Gyroid
Support Material Percentage: 18%



Notes: 

This file pack is for the receiver only. Other printed part files will need to be downloaded from the base design release; 
links provided in the below text.



Base UBAR-9 files can be found on DefCAD & Odysee: 

DefCAD: https://defcad.com/library/b0bf3c45-de63-4f87-a1a2-d8d60a5a4406/

Odysee: https://odysee.com/@RKSpookware:2/UBAR9:0

(Other print settings and the hardware list will be provided in the base data pack)



Hardware for the UBAR-9 can be bought from: https://rkspookware.com/ubar-9-lower-receiver-hardware-kit/



Accreditations:

RK Spookware: Creator of the UBAR-9 Receiver; used the base receiver model from their design release. Provided hardware. 
Provided images for reference.
